knownAuthorityGap.currentSource: compact acquisition provenance for new runs and checked schedule evidence for the historical corpus
knownAuthorityGap.problem: authoritative MLB-game RDF does not yet represent game type or corpus-fixture membership
knownAuthorityGap.requiredResolution: ontologist-approved RDF model and historical backfill before claiming RDF-only rebuildability

advanced-reviewed-catalog.grain: per-game reviewed query bindings in one independently named SQL table per DSQ, with query-specific SQL-selected reduction

execution.indexedSelection: only operational-query-routing autoLayer=indexed routes with preserved equivalence evidence

complete-static-dsq-catalog.grain: one exact SPARQL result partition per authoritative game graph in a dedicated table for each DSQ

explore.grain: indexed RDF identities plus bounded authoritative context at event grain

empty-games-and-derived.grain: one completeness-gated batter-game-pitcher row plus PA damage opportunities

options.admissionScope: filters for plate-appearance-quality and good-at-bat only
options.grain: distinct values from materialized game and event dimensions

grains.game_dimension: one row per authoritative game graph
grains.plate_appearance_fact: one row per plate appearance with MLB outcome, pitch/event counts, runner resolutions, and PAQ components
grains.advanced_result_fact: compatibility copy of reviewed advanced-query result rows while existing advanced candidate readers migrate to their dedicated DSQ tables
grains.dsq_query_manifest: one immutable contract row per materialized DSQ naming its query hash, reducer, projected variables, dedicated table, and binding count
grains.dsq_*: one dedicated persistent table per approved static DSQ; rows retain exact RDF bindings and authoritative game-graph scope before SQL reduction
grains.pitch_fact: one pitch with its final MLB call code
grains.assignment_fact: one game-scoped team or official assignment
grains.empty_damage_fact: one failed plate appearance with damage inputs
